summary: Pop Culture Group Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice and proxy materials for an Extraordinary General Meeting to be held October 22, 2026, at its Xiamen, Fujian offices, with a record date of October 5, 2026. Shareholders will vote on a special resolution to migrate the company's registration by way of continuation from the Cayman Islands to the British Virgin Islands, adopting amended and restated memorandum and articles upon effectiveness, plus an ordinary adjournment resolution to solicit further proxies if votes are insufficient. No price, stake, or transaction terms are stated; this is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation.
